title: Minecraft Bedrock resource-pack flaw affected 26.52–26.63, fixed in 26.65
summary: A publicly reported vulnerability in Minecraft Bedrock allowed resource packs carrying a content.zipe file to alter Ore UI files and run hidden scripts when auto-download was enabled on servers or Realms. Developer 8Crafter said in a November 15 Reddit disclosure that it affected versions 26.52 through 26.63, possibly earlier releases, across PC, mobile and console; Java Edition was unaffected. Mojang fixed the issue in version 26.65, and AxmBro released a Windows read-only detection tool that can find content.zipe but cannot determine whether a resource pack is malicious.
